notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market-year 2025/26 (trader reference). Years differ.

Customs data record 0.54 Mt of soybean meal exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI); USDA PSD gives 0.8 Mt for 2023/24 and 0.8 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here.
discrepancies: World exports: USDA PSD 2025/26 86.6 Mt (sum of reporting countries, EU excl. intra-trade) vs BACI 2024 73.8 Mt (+17%); different year and basis (marketing year vs calendar year; BACI includes intra-EU trade, PSD does not); PSD shown in the table.
